Welcome back to the AI Daily Brief
headlines edition, all the daily AI news

of the big stories from last week
revolved around Open AI's security
testing of an unnamed model, which
people presume to be GPT-6. Both Hugging

the attack telling the story from their
view.
Open AI's blog post released on
Wednesday suggested that they were

full investigation, implying the two
companies were on good terms. That

AI.

Now, in the few days since Open AI
disclosed the incident, we've had a

Journal wrote that Hugging Face was
caught completely off guard by the
attack, which seemed to be superhuman

And this idea of rogue, that the model

a piece titled, "Its AI agent spent days
hacking a company, but sources say
OpenAI did not notice for a week."
Contends Reuters. The OpenAI agent that
broke into tech firm Hugging Face went
on a days-long hacking spree that OpenAI

threat was contained and the FBI was

its attempt to break out of its testing

Reportedly, the two companies didn't

before OpenAI's public disclosure.
According to the timeline presented by
Reuters, the agent was on the loose for

For some, the reporting raises more
questions that it provides answers.
Marley Smith, principal intelligence
specialist at the nonprofit World

Now, a spokesperson for OpenAI said the
reporting contains several inaccuracies,

technical report.
Now, Reuters sources gave a little bit
more background on how something like
